## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that solves it.

## Related Issue

Link the issue when applicable, for example: `Closes #123`.

## Changes

- Describe the primary change.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run test:run`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` (when the change affects a browser workflow)
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Manual verification completed (describe below)

## Screenshots or Recordings

Include before/after evidence for visible UI changes, or write “Not applicable.”

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated edits.
- [ ] Tests or model fixtures were added or updated when behavior changed.
- [ ] Documentation was updated when setup, behavior, or contributor workflow changed.
- [ ] No secrets, generated dependencies, or unrelated build artifacts are included.
